SessionStart.command: $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; if (git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/beta 2>$null) { git push origin beta:refs/tags/archive/beta-$ts 2>$null }; git checkout -B beta main

PreToolUse.command: $branch = git branch --show-current 2>$null; if ($branch -ne 'beta') { git checkout beta 2>$null; Write-Host '[hook] switched to beta' }
